workflowCorpus.split: all delivered tasks are visible calibration; no held-out task or oracle is included
workflowCorpus.heldoutReservation: whole substrate/template/fault-family identities reserved before tuning in the corpus manifest; metadata only, no isolation claim
workflowCorpus.redGreenAndAdequacyEvidence: test/campaign-workflows.test.ts records the review seed red and reference/alternative repairs green; independently judged task bundles cover the additional operation families, with corpus counts and visible-calibration limits in workflows.json
workflowCorpus.independentSubstrates: 9 independently judged task substrates across the locally mocked workflow families; no adequacy or held-out claim follows from these counts
workflowCorpus.coverageLimit: Visible calibration only: 9 independently judged task substrates; no held-out isolation or 20-task-per-role adequacy claim
workflowCorpus.hostJudge: runner/workflow-corpus/review-loop-judge.ts exports judgeReviewLoopWorkspace and judgeReviewLoopRepairTask; v2 settings/module.js semantic conformance accepts multiple implementations, executes candidate code through executeProtectedJudgeChild with a 5000ms bound, and candidate identity separately hashes actual patch bytes
workflowCorpus.runSuiteAdapter: runner/workflow-corpus/review-loop-suite.ts adapts the v2 settings/ fixture and its host-pinned oracle into a typed SuiteCase; wrapped Driver captures the materialized baseline before delegation and leaves candidate HEAD and index intact
workflowCorpus.toolkitTestFixFinding: pinned dd247ca source test-fix.ts:64-66 omits stagePathAllowlist; sweep.ts:392-395,417-418 therefore applies package-prefix default; details and reproduction in runner/workflow-corpus/README.md
workflowCorpus.pristineBaselineIntegrity: review task factory creates a fresh local Git seed; runSuite adapter captures the actual materialized workspace baseline before delegation, supplies its full SHA and pinned semantic oracle through hostCheckScoringEnvironment, and handles model-created commits; no toolkit or fixtures checkout was mutated

scope.stage: S0 bounded dependency reconciliation plus bounded visible S5 workflow corpus slice
